ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious PowerShell Invocations - Generic
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects suspicious PowerShell invocation command parameters Note: Unmapped fields: ScriptBlockText

sequences.query: ((ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\ \\-enc\\ .*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\ \\-EncodedCommand\\ .*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\ \\-ec\\ .*")) AND (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\ \\-w\\ hidden\\ .*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\ \\-window\\ hidden\\ .*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\ \\-windowstyle\\ hidden\\ .*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\ \\-w\\ 1\\ .*")) AND (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\ \\-noni\\ .*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\ \\-noninteractive\\ .*")))
